forbidden_claims: rainfall-driven washout is the dominant event-window mechanism
the index directly measures PM concentration or exact visibility
the point wind is the regional maximum wind for the entire dust storm
required_claims: index indicates high dust mobility with limited wet removal
two dry windy days support continued dust transport during the short event window
annual embedding change should not be interpreted as direct dust concentration or structural damage

criteria.description: Returns high_dust_mobility_low_wet_removal or an equivalent compact interpretation.
criteria.name: Interpretation label
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for identifying dust mobility but missing limited wet removal or using an imprecise label.

criteria.description: Computes the index near 6.5 from 22.1 divided by 1 plus 2.4.
criteria.name: Index calculation
criteria.partial_credit: 1-3 points for using the correct formula but with one incorrect input or rounding issue.

criteria.description: Reports peak wind near 22.1 km/h and uses it as the numerator of the index.
criteria.name: Peak wind term
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for reporting the wind but not clearly using it in the formula.

criteria.description: Reports the wettest precipitation candidate near 2.4 mm and explains its low wet-removal implication.
criteria.name: Wetness denominator
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for reporting a precipitation value but not connecting it to washout.

criteria.description: Counts two dry windy days using wind at least 18 km/h and precipitation at most 1 mm.
criteria.name: Dry windy day count
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for applying only one of the two thresholds or giving an off-by-one count.

criteria.description: Connects the index result to dust transport and limited wet removal rather than hydrologic washout.
criteria.name: Physical diagnosis
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for naming dust transport without contrasting it with wet removal.

criteria.description: Avoids unsupported claims about PM concentration, exact visibility, confirmed direct impacts, structural land-cover damage, or regional maximum winds.
criteria.name: Boundary of inference
criteria.partial_credit: 1-2 points for avoiding most overclaims but still overstating one metric.
